description: Reserve a Harris Teeter pickup window and create the checkout for the current cart. Returns the real totals (coupons, fees, tax) and a link; the order is NOT placed and nothing is charged — the user reviews it and presses "Place Order" on harristeeter.com. Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE).

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

window.description: The pickup window exactly as ht_list_timeslots returned it, e.g. "2026-11-12T22:00:00Z/2026-11-12T23:00:00Z".

name: ht_start_checkout
